claims.citation: New York Herald, 5 July 1866, p. 5, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
NORFOLK, July 1—Sld steamship Ephesus (Br), Collins,
London.

claims.claim: Incident Sable Island Sable Island (5th[?] inst)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 July 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
STEAMSHIP EPHESUS, Collins, from Norfolk, Va, 1st inst for
Liverpool, with a cargo of tobacco, cotton, rosin, &c, was
stranded on Sable Island 5th[?] inst. The crew, forty in num-
ber, arrived at Halifax 22d inst in the government schr Dar-
ing. Part of the cargo saved, but the latest accounts repre-
sent the steamer as breaking up.
